nd9fa646555.headline: India-EU FTA: Which liquor brands could get cheaper with the ‘mother of all deals’
nd9fa646555.summary: Imported European wines, whiskies and beers are set to become significantly cheaper in India after the conclusion of a free trade agreement with the EU.
nd9fa646555.why: Free trade agreements reduce tariffs, changing import costs and market access for exporters and importers.

n737e75014e.headline: ECB must prepare for new shocks including Russian aggression, Simkus says
n737e75014e.summary: European Central Bank policy fits the current moment and the economy has adapted well to volatility, according to Simkus. The bank must still prepare for new shocks, possibly from Russia's military threat.
n737e75014e.why: The European Central Bank sets monetary policy for the euro area, so its assessment of risks shapes euro rates, bond yields and the currency.

n1c371bdbb0.headline: Spain starts program to legalize up to half-million migrants
n1c371bdbb0.summary: Spain has started a program to grant legal status to 500,000 undocumented migrants, announced in January. The move aims to reduce labor shortages and runs against anti-immigration policies in parts of Europe and the US.
n1c371bdbb0.why: Migrant labor affects labor supply, tax revenue and sectors such as agriculture, construction and services in Spain's economy.

n38c46aba54.headline: What Is OCI Card? European Council Chief Antonio Costa Flaunts It As India, EU Seal Trade Deal
n38c46aba54.summary: India and the European Union have concluded a free trade agreement, which PM Narendra Modi said adds a decisive chapter to ties between the two democracies. European Council President Antonio Costa attended the announcement.
n38c46aba54.why: Free trade agreements lower tariffs and barriers, which can expand trade flows and investment between India and the European Union.

n153b4b8eb3.headline: Tyre industry flags natural rubber shortage, seeks government intervention
n153b4b8eb3.summary: The Automotive Tyre Manufacturers' Association said domestic natural rubber supplies are severely constrained, with prices climbing steadily toward ₹200 per kg.
n153b4b8eb3.why: Natural rubber is a key raw material for tyre makers, so shortages and price rises affect manufacturing costs across the automotive sector.

n1ff2d800ff.headline: Louis Vuitton Owner LVMH Closes Year-End Quarter With Weak Sales Growth -- 2nd Update
n1ff2d800ff.summary: LVMH wrapped up its final quarter of last year with sluggish sales growth. The result suggests shoppers were not splurging on its high-end collections.
n1ff2d800ff.why: LVMH is the world's largest luxury goods group, and its sales trends are a bellwether for global high-end consumer demand.

n73de1736fe.headline: Bursa extends rally to fresh multi-year high, CI up 1.55%
n73de1736fe.summary: The benchmark index rallied 1.55% to its highest level since 2018. The move was driven by sustained foreign buying and broad blue-chip participation, an analyst said.
n73de1736fe.why: Bursa Malaysia is the country's stock exchange, and its benchmark index reflects the performance of major Malaysian companies and foreign investor interest.

n8f00a5625a.headline: Nextpower (NXT) Q3 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
n8f00a5625a.summary: Nextpower's earnings call described a strong quarter with increased backlog and operational discipline, its first quarterly report under the new Nextpower Inc. name.
n8f00a5625a.why: Nextpower makes solar tracking and energy equipment, so its backlog and order trends signal demand in the renewable power sector.

n118e210a5e.headline: Omax Autos Net Profit Soars To ₹12.2 Crore In Q3 FY26, Revenue Jumps 41% QoQ To ₹124.2 Crore
n118e210a5e.summary: Omax Autos reported Q3 FY26 net profit of Rs 12.2 crore, up from Rs 0.34 crore in Q2. Revenue rose 41 percent quarter on quarter to Rs 124.2 crore, driven by strong demand and better cost control.
n118e210a5e.why: Omax Autos is an Indian automotive components maker, so its quarterly results indicate demand and margin trends in India's auto supply chain.

n862d8b1046.headline: What happened at the protests in Iran?
n862d8b1046.summary: Protests erupted across Iran on 28 December 2025, with people outraged at decades of repression demanding fundamental change. Amnesty International Australia has reported on the unrest.
n862d8b1046.why: Political instability in Iran affects regional energy supply risk and sanctions dynamics, which matter for oil prices and emerging-market investors.

nd62f7aab52.headline: China warns citizens against Japan visits during Lunar New Year
nd62f7aab52.summary: China's foreign ministry said its nationals face serious security threats in Japan and issued a warning against visits during the Lunar New Year period.
nd62f7aab52.why: Chinese visitors are a major source of tourism spending in Japan, so travel advisories can affect airlines, hotels and retailers.

nbc32090f73.headline: Axis Bank Shares Jump Over 5% on Q3 Results
nbc32090f73.summary: Axis Bank shares surged on the BSE after the bank reported a rise in net profit for the quarter ended December 31, 2025, trading up 5.37% at ₹1,327.80.
nbc32090f73.why: Axis Bank is one of India's largest private-sector lenders, and its quarterly results are closely watched by investors in Indian banking stocks.

impacts.name: Axis Bank
impacts.why: Higher reported net profit for the December quarter drove the share price gain on the BSE.

n7ff3c2c875.headline: Ringgit ends at fresh 7-year high against dollar
n7ff3c2c875.summary: The ringgit ended at a fresh seven-year high against the dollar. An analyst said sentiment remains supportive, though markets are cautious on the direction of interest rates in 2026.
n7ff3c2c875.why: The ringgit is Malaysia's currency, and its strength affects import costs, foreign investment flows and returns on Malaysian assets for foreign investors.

n081d038594.headline: Indian carmakers slide on sharp tariff cuts for European imports
n081d038594.summary: Indian car manufacturers saw their shares fall after the announcement of sharp tariff cuts on European car imports. The move raised concerns over competitiveness in the domestic market.
n081d038594.why: Tariff cuts on imported cars increase competition for domestic automakers, which can compress their pricing and market share.
n081d038594.why_moved: Announced sharp tariff cuts on European car imports raised concerns about the competitiveness of Indian carmakers.

n9f7e36d2b0.headline: US Strikes Iran? Loud Explosion Reported At Parchin Nuclear And Military Site As America Mobilises Forces In The Middle East | Watch
n9f7e36d2b0.summary: An explosion was reported at Iran's Parchin nuclear and military site amid US force mobilisation in the Middle East. The reports fuelled speculation over a possible American strike.
n9f7e36d2b0.why: Military escalation involving Iran matters to investors because it can disrupt oil flows and raise regional risk premiums.

n84671a919e.headline: EU-India trade deal falls short of car industry goals
n84671a919e.summary: The EU-India trade deal lowers car tariffs, but they remain too high for most Indians to afford a European car. The deal falls short of car industry goals.
n84671a919e.why: Trade agreements set tariff levels that determine export access for European automakers and competition in India's large car market.

nb3d71284f7.headline: What's next for USDJPY as the bearish momentum from intervention risk wanes?
nb3d71284f7.summary: The USD/JPY pair trades around the 154.50 support zone as bearish momentum from intervention talks wanes. The report asks what comes next for the pair.
nb3d71284f7.why: The yen is a major currency, and Japanese authorities' willingness to intervene in FX markets affects dollar-yen moves that matter for global investors.

nb0a946836b.headline: European carmakers gain major access as India eases tariffs under EU FTA
nb0a946836b.summary: The India-EU free trade agreement gives European automakers preferential access through large import quotas and phased tariff cuts on ICE and electric vehicles. The deal eases tariffs for the sector.
nb0a946836b.why: Car import tariffs are a major barrier for foreign automakers in India, so preferential access can shift market share and export plans for European manufacturers.

n81b2f4a60e.headline: The Indian Rupee stalls around record lows as the EU and India sign a historic trade deal
n81b2f4a60e.summary: The rupee is consolidating near record lows against the dollar even as the EU and India sign a historic trade deal. Technical analysis describes the pair at the upper bound of a rising channel.
n81b2f4a60e.why: The rupee's level against the dollar affects import costs, foreign investment flows and returns for overseas investors in Indian assets.

impacts.why: The rupee is trading near record lows against the dollar.

nc5b12359cb.headline: North American Morning Briefing :  Nasdaq Futures Rise; Trade Relations, Earnings in Focus -2-
nc5b12359cb.summary: February natural gas futures settled up 29% on the New York Mercantile Exchange at $6.800 per million British thermal units after hitting an intraday high of $7.439.
nc5b12359cb.why: Natural gas is a key energy input for power generation and heating. Futures on NYMEX are the main US benchmark for gas prices.
nc5b12359cb.why_moved: The February delivery contract jumped sharply in one session, reaching an intraday high of $7.439 before settling at $6.800.

nce9d0ef62b.headline: Ringgit holds firm below 4.00 as markets position for FOMC
nce9d0ef62b.summary: The ringgit closed below the psychological 4.00 level against the US dollar, supported by positive sentiment and investor positioning ahead of the upcoming FOMC meeting.
nce9d0ef62b.why: The Federal Open Market Committee sets US interest-rate policy, which shifts dollar demand and affects emerging-market currencies such as the ringgit.

nd4e1260b77.headline: Exclusive-China buys more Canadian canola after Mark Carney visit
nd4e1260b77.summary: Chinese importers secured up to 10 Canadian canola cargoes following Prime Minister Mark Carney's visit to Beijing, according to Reuters sources cited in the report.
nd4e1260b77.why: Canada is a major canola exporter, and China is one of its largest buyers of the oilseed used in cooking oil and animal feed.

n1e6b1f21d5.headline: Broader Market Rallies on Tech Strength and Solid Earnings
n1e6b1f21d5.summary: The S&P 500 rose 0.47% and the Nasdaq 100 gained 0.87%, while the Dow fell 0.84%, with March E-mini S&P futures up 0.48%.
n1e6b1f21d5.why: The S&P 500 tracks 500 large US companies and is the main benchmark for US equity performance.

impacts.why: The index itself rose 0.47% on the session, driven by tech strength and earnings.

nc5d4b932cb.headline: Bangladesh sees remittance surge to $2.71b in January
nc5d4b932cb.summary: Bangladesh received $2.71 billion in remittances in January. Expatriate Bangladeshis sent home $88 million on January 26 alone.
nc5d4b932cb.why: Remittances are a major source of foreign currency for Bangladesh and support its current account, reserves and taka stability.

ne4fc89ec4b.headline: Japan’s midsize insurers hold back from bond buys anticipating rebound
ne4fc89ec4b.summary: Japan's midsize insurers are holding back from buying bonds, expecting yields to rise further. Government spending plans have also slowed their buying.
ne4fc89ec4b.why: Japanese insurers are large holders of domestic government bonds, so their buying decisions influence demand in the JGB market.

n9d8e113e22.headline: Tokyo condo prices hit record high on tight supply and surging building costs
n9d8e113e22.summary: The average price of a new condo in Tokyo and surrounding areas rose 17% to ¥91.8 million, a record, on tight supply and surging building costs.
n9d8e113e22.why: Tokyo is Japan's economic centre, and housing prices shape household wealth and construction activity. Rising costs feed into real estate valuations.

nd4a4131404.headline: ONYX Hospitality Group Signs Agreement to Manage Shama Hub Ladprao
nd4a4131404.summary: ONYX Hospitality Group has signed an agreement to manage Shama Hub Ladprao. The deal reflects the owner's confidence in continued investment.
nd4a4131404.why: ONYX Hospitality is a hotel management company that operates properties under management contracts. Such deals expand its fee-based portfolio.

n53916d733e.headline: What To Expect From Stock Market Today? Sensex, Nifty 50 Rides On Global Markets and India–EU Trade Optimism
n53916d733e.summary: Indian markets may open higher after Friday's sharp sell-off, supported by Gift Nifty strength and positive global cues. Optimism over an India–EU trade agreement and easing tariff worries are also cited.
n53916d733e.why: The Sensex and Nifty 50 are the benchmark indexes of the Indian stock market, tracking the largest listed companies in the country.

impacts.why: The input cites Gift Nifty strength and easing tariff worries as support for a higher open.

ndc6401311c.headline: Consumer confidence reaches nine-month high - Taipei Times
ndc6401311c.summary: Taiwan's consumer confidence reached a nine-month high this month, after Taipei and Washington verbally agreed on a tariff deal on January 15. A National Central University survey showed the improvement.
ndc6401311c.why: Consumer confidence is a leading indicator of household spending, which drives a large share of economic growth.

ncd969b0822.headline: London open: FTSE gains on positive US, Asian cues; Sage Group rises after update
ncd969b0822.summary: London stocks gained early Tuesday, supported by positive sessions in the US and Asia as investors awaited the Federal Reserve's policy announcement and upcoming US tech earnings.
ncd969b0822.why: The FTSE 100 is a key European equity index influenced by global market sentiment and central bank policies, impacting investor risk appetite and capital flows.
ncd969b0822.why_moved: Global investor optimism from US and Asian markets ahead of the Fed policy update boosted UK equities, lifting the FTSE 100.

na63d1cda62.headline: ECB's Kocher sees inflation risks in both directions, stresses full optionality
na63d1cda62.summary: Martin Kocher, governor of the Austrian National Bank, highlighted inflation risks in both directions and emphasized the European Central Bank's need to maintain full policy flexibility.
na63d1cda62.why: ECB policy decisions influence eurozone interest rates, inflation outlook, and financial markets.
na63d1cda62.why_moved: Comments on inflation risks and ECB policy flexibility influence market expectations for eurozone rates.
